methodology.objective: maximise Σ value(task) − Σ completion time (min) + small bonus for keeping human assignments
methodology.value: value = Σ weight_k × component_k (life / infra / economic, each normalised 0–100 across candidates)
methodology.verification: every solution is re-simulated by the time-dependent plan evaluator; infeasible arcs are corrected or forbidden and the model re-solved
